summary: Restocks are frequent but sell out in about a minute; mornings (around 9-11 AM) are the best time, so act on the alert instantly.

items.title: Overnight NYC drops at Bay Plaza and Brooklyn on Oct 28
items.summary: Around 1:15 AM ET, Bay Plaza, Downtown Brooklyn and Williamsburg showed 256GB pickup stock; the Brooklyn units lasted about a minute. No NJ store was listed.

items.title: Oct 27 was the busiest restock day yet
items.summary: The tracker logged about 1,369 US store restocks on Tuesday, up from roughly 400 Monday. Half arrive between 9:30 and 10:40 AM local time, and a typical drop lasts one minute.

items.title: Manzana: mornings and Tuesdays are best
items.summary: Its latest US drop came at 11:51 AM ET on Oct 27, with pickup at just 5 of 269 stores. It sees most restocks from 9 AM to noon ET, most often on Tuesdays.
